 Franz Wagner flirts with triple-double in loss to Warriors 
 by Chris Schommer | Magic Correspondent | Mon, Nov 9th 2026, 12:11pm EST 
 Franz Wagner flirted with a triple-double for the Magic Saturday night, dishing out 11 assists, grabbing six rebounds, and scoring 30 points (11-22 FG, 3-7 3PT, 5-5 FT) while also recording two steals in a 126-119 loss to the Warriors. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Wagner continues a solid stretch on both ends of the floor, grabbing three or more rebounds, dishing out six or more assists, and scoring 14 or more points in each of his last five contests. The forward remains one of the more impactful options in the Orlando starting five for head coach Sean Sweeney, averaging 20.8 points, 6.3 rebounds, and 8.8 assists per game while carrying a usage rate of 27.8% so far this season.
